slices.title: SPA status cues
slices.summary: Builds the SPA cues: one lifecycle-notices node per turn (capped at 20, de-duplicated), a retrying tool state, one polite live-region sentence per notice, localized strings with a generic fallback for unknown tokens, and no local persistence for temporary or ZDR threads. Flips MODEL_GATEWAY_LIFECYCLE_EVENTS to default true at its DoD.

slices.title: hook_context into Do runs, strictest-wins evaluator, fail-closed
slices.summary: Passes the org hook context into Do runs in place of the empty string, replaces first-match with a strictest-wins evaluator (deny over ask over allow) that fails closed on malformed context, and withholds the result of a denied post-tool call while keeping the step successful. Adds an OrgPolicyContext message as RunAgentRequest.org_policy at binding tag 24, and a priority field at tag 8 on the gateway Hook message.

cd "apps/Model Plane/rust" && cargo test -p model-gateway hook_rules

Frames never carry paths or content.
